arguments.hindsight: I should have cleared the idle arm before rotating the charger and used a side view to verify pin alignment and insertion depth before releasing. Repeated regrasping and camera repositioning exhausted the motion budget.
arguments.reason: The charger is not fully inserted, and only nine environment steps remain—insufficient to align, insert, release, and return safely.
